question: When will Beyond UX Design episodes be released to free listeners after the early access model launches?
transcript_excerpt: New episodes will go to paid members first and then a week later they'll come out for everybody else on the feed completely for free. The next episode will be available for everybody on Thursday, November 12th.

question: How much does Beyond UX Design early access cost per month?
transcript_excerpt: For $5 a month, you get finished episodes a week early in audio and video, plus the full archive of video episodes. You can join on Spotify or Patreon.
